items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: Dr. Skyton was ahead of it.

ctx.x: Did you have lessons yourself, musical lessons?

Yes, I studied pretty, uh, pretty much. And, uh, then I attended the New Orleans Conservatory, which is affiliated, I believe, now with, uh, Loyola School of Music. But at the time it was called the New Orleans Conservatory. Uh, Dr. Skyton was ahead of it. And, uh, we had the New Orleans Symphony, I played bassoon in the New Orleans Symphony. And what I did was try to... You tried what? Bassoon.
